meta.title: Coach Marcus Reid | Precision Football Training — Charlotte, NC
meta.description: Charlotte's precision football coach. Technical mastery for athletes who demand the edge.

about.name: Coach Marcus Reid
about.title: Head Football Coach
about.bio: Coach Marcus Reid is one of the most technically precise offensive line coaches in the Southeast. A former college starter at Virginia Tech, he spent years studying film, refining footwork progressions, and building the kind of position-specific knowledge base that college programs pay top dollar for. His athletes don't just get bigger — they get smarter, technically sharper, and more ready to compete at the next level.
about.age_groups: Middle School · High School · College Prep

hero.headline: The Trenches Win Games
hero.subline: Offensive line development for athletes who want to be the most technically sound player on the field.

services.title: OL Footwork & Stance
services.description: The foundation of every elite lineman. Stance, initial step, kick slide, and set mechanics drilled to precision.

services.title: Run Blocking Mastery
services.description: Drive blocks, combo blocks, pull technique, and point-of-attack domination for every blocking scheme.

services.title: Pass Protection & Film
services.description: Pass sets, hands technique, anchor strength, and reading defensive fronts — includes film review.

success_stories.story: Twelve months of footwork refinement and film study. Signed with Wake Forest on National Signing Day.
Improved hand placement and pass set mechanics earned Chris a second look — and a scholarship offer — from his D2 program.

testimonials.quote: Coach Reid broke down film with my son like a college coordinator would. He doesn't just teach technique — he teaches the game.

faq.question: Do you only train offensive linemen?
faq.answer: My primary expertise is OL, but I also work with tight ends on blocking mechanics and sometimes linebackers on point-of-attack technique.

faq.question: What makes your program different?
faq.answer: Film is part of every session. My athletes don't just drill — they understand why each technique works, so they can self-correct on the field.

faq.question: How do I apply?
faq.answer: Fill out the contact form and describe your athlete's current level and goals. I schedule an evaluation session before committing to a training plan.
